notes.subject: fix(webview): render provider citation markers safely
notes.summary: Chat replies now hide unresolved provider citation markers, including partial ones while streaming, and show safe HTTP(S) source links when citation metadata maps them.

notes.subject: fix(skills): allow reference reads in context view
notes.summary: Reading a skill's reference files through the context view no longer requires outside-workspace approval when the skill is in the session catalogue.

notes.subject: fix(sandbox): isolate npm cache and retain early cancellation
notes.summary: Sandboxed commands now use a private per-command npm cache while keeping the normal HOME, honour early cancellation during startup, and give clearer npm cache recovery guidance.

notes.subject: fix(desktop): pad the desktop update header button
notes.summary: Adds proper padding to the update indicator button in the Desktop header.

notes.subject: feat(skills): separate skill activation from resource reads
notes.summary: Adds a read_skill_resource tool for paginated, non-activating reads of built-in skill files; load_skill now activates only SKILL.md files and returns a compatibility result for legacy reference paths.

notes.subject: feat(skills): activate user-selected skills directly
notes.summary: Selecting a skill from the slash picker now activates it directly on the host before the model request, with an Activated by you card, stale-revision handling, and queued-message recovery.
